images.title: He whispers, she smirks — full silhouette
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: uncropped full-body source photograph for the 9takes homepage, intended for later manual cropping.
Edit and expand the supplied image. The ONLY creative change is camera distance/framing and the necessary continuation of the bodies below the original crop. Preserve the recognizable figures, faces, hair, expressions, upper-body relationship, whispering action, and dry weathered stone aesthetic.
MOST IMPORTANT: show BOTH ENTIRE FIGURES HEAD TO TOE. The full outer silhouette of each person must fit completely inside the image. Pull the camera back substantially and expand the scene outward on every side. No part of a head, curl, shoulder, elbow, hand, finger, robe, leg, heel, foot, or toe may touch or extend beyond any canvas edge. Leave generous continuous black negative space on all four sides: at least 12% of canvas height above the tallest head and below the lowest foot, and at least 10% of canvas width on the left and right of the widest silhouette. The whole group occupies approximately the central 72–76% of canvas height. This is a wide full-length view, never a bust, torso crop, waist-up or knee-up shot. Keep actual detailed stone subjects, not flat silhouette shapes.
Preserve the man whispering into the woman's ear, his near hand cupped beside his mouth and his other hand resting on her far shoulder. Preserve her slightly turned head, lowered carved eyelids, and small knowing half-smile. Extend both into anatomically plausible full-length standing Greek statues, the man leaning subtly toward her. Their carved classical robes fall naturally to the ankles. Both pairs of feet are completely visible. The woman's free arms rest naturally with her robes.
Maintain natural distinct anatomical limbs, five fingers on each hand, coherent contact between the whispering pair, physically convincing weight and balance. Complete feet are as important as complete heads. Keep the figures close enough for the whisper to be plausible.
Material and lighting must match the supplied approved image: physically carved dry matte weathered grey marble or limestone, fine irregular pitting and worn chisel marks, small edge chips, restrained localized grime, solid blank stone eyes, subtly carved expressions. Ash, chalk and charcoal palette; one believable upper-left raking light with visible detail in the shadows. Preserve readable separation along the whole outer contour, including dark robe edges and feet. Neutral unadorned black background extending around the entire group, a nearly black ground plane with only subtle contact shadows beneath feet. No pedestal. No bright rim glow, new colored light, added scenery, decorative objects, text, logos or watermark.
Output a detailed high-resolution 2048 x 2560 portrait image, 4:5 aspect ratio, one full composition. Prioritize complete silhouettes and generous crop margins over filling the frame.
